newsitem.title: THAILAND: Kiatnakin says protected from baht moves.
newsitem.headline: Kiatnakin says protected from baht moves.

text.p: Thailand's Kiatnakin Finance and Securities Plc has protected its $70.14 million in foreign loans against foreign exchange fluctuations, the firm said in a statement on Wednesday.
The weakened baht posed a risk to the firm only in the small portion of overdue interest payable on loans, Kiatnakin said.
Many Thai companies face exchange losses on foreign denominated loans after the baht was floated last Wednesday.
The float ended a 13 year period in which the baht was pegged to a basket of currencies dominated by the U.S. dollar. The baht has weakened by more than 15 percent since the float.
